items.title: The Land of the Standing-Up Rocks
items.content_text: A national monument since the 1920s, Chiricahua is America’s newest national park.

items.title: A-81 Reaches South Georgia
items.content_text: The Antarctic iceberg made a relatively quick exit from the Weddell Sea, only to slow at the edge of a remote island’s underwater shelf.
